verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents its own bulk capabilities. These include bulk search with one-click add-to-cart for all available results, bulk transfer of domains all at once, folder-wide domain adjustments, and an API marketed for large bulk adjustments. The documentation is marketing-level, though, and does not show batch endpoints, limits, or bulk actions through the MCP/AI assistant path. Missing for 10: documented batch API endpoints and limits for bulk renew/DNS/settings changes, evidence that MCP supports multi-item operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: If you're looking to make large bulk adjustments to your account or domains, our API makes the process quick, efficient, and accurate.
make folder-wide domain name adjustments to help you stay organized.
Add all available searched domains to your cart with one click.
Transfer your domains from another provider to Dynadot all at once.
